summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Eurylochus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos; not to be confused with Autonoe daughter of Cadmus at Thebes.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Autonoe first among the twelve daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. The twelve sons of Egyptus by the Naiad Caliadne cast lots for them; Eurylochus drew Autonoe. On the wedding night Danaus gave each daughter a dagger, and like her sisters she obeyed her father's command — Hyginus names her among the brides who slew their husbands.
